thread.title: Apple’s Earnings Are Already Hitting the Dow Jones Industrial Average

author: Ben Levisohn
title: Apple’s Earnings Are Already Hitting the Dow Jones Industrial Average
text: Apple’s Earnings Are Already Hitting the Dow Jones Industrial Average Ben Levisohn Reblog 5:11 p.m. (AAPL) disappointing guidance is already hitting the stock market, and could end the Dow Jones Industrial Average’s three-day winning streak. Apple’s shares are off 4.4% at $212.45, and its loss is already being felt by the ETFs that track the major indexes. The (QQQ), which tracks the Nasdaq-100, is off 0.7% at $170.87, while the (SPY), has fallen 0.3% to $272.78, and the (DIA) has declined 0.3% to $252.96.
